submission.natural_language_explanation: A near-dead, threshold-like latent that fires weakly on the token ' the' (and on 'The' at a line start; very weakly ' a'), but only when the token sits late in the 128-token window (absolute position about 90 or later) and an ASCII control-character token such as form feed \f, tab \t, carriage return \r, ESC or NUL (not newline, spaces or printable punctuation) appeared within roughly the previous 40 tokens. It is zero if any one of these is missing: the control character, the late position, or a ' the'-type current token. More control characters, closer ones and a preceding ' to' push it higher.
